{"returnValue":"(event EventBeginPlay
  (Variables|Default|SetWheelX 440.0)
  (Variables|Default|SetWheelDirection 1.0)
  (Variables|Default|SetIsLow true)
  (Variables|Default|SetMenuOpen false)
  (Variables|Default|SetWheelSolved false)
  (Variables|Default|SetLiftAlpha 0.0)
  (Variables|Default|SetLiftActive false)
  (Variables|Default|SetLiftSolved false)
  (bind _returnvalue (UserInterface|CreateWidget "/Game/Stage1Generated/WBP_Stage1Settings.WBP_Stage1Settings_C" (Game|GetPlayerController 0)))
  (Variables|Default|SetSettingsWidget _returnvalue)
  (UserInterface|Viewport|AddToViewport _returnvalue 10)
  (Widget|SetVisibility _returnvalue "Collapsed")
  (bind _outactors (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageHigh"))
  (for _array_element _outactors
    (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame _array_element true))
  (bind _outactors_1 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageLow"))
  (for _array_element_1 _outactors_1
    (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame _array_element_1))
  (Development|PrintString "A/D: MOVE | ESC: SETTINGS | Q: QUICK QUALITY | E: LIFT" true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 12.0))

(event Collision|EventActorBeginOverlap (OtherActor))

(event EventTick (DeltaSeconds)
  (bind _returnvalue (Game|GetPlayerController 0))
  (bind _islow (Variables|Default|GetIsLow))
  (bind _wheelx (Variables|Default|GetWheelX))
  (bind _islow_1 (Variables|Default|GetIsLow))
  (bind _liftalpha (Variables|Default|GetLiftAlpha))
  (Variables|Default|SetQualityChanged false)
  (if (or (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "Escape") (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "M"))
    (Variables|Default|SetMenuOpen (not (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)))
    (if (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)
      (Widget|SetVisibility (Variables|Default|GetSettingsWidget))
      (Input|SetIgnoreMoveInput _returnvalue true)
      (else
        (Widget|SetVisibility (Variables|Default|GetSettingsWidget) "Collapsed")
        (Input|SetIgnoreMoveInput _returnvalue))))
  (if (and (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen) (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "One"))
    (Variables|Default|SetIsLow true)
    (Variables|Default|SetQualityChanged true))
  (if (and (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen) (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "Two"))
    (Variables|Default|SetIsLow false)
    (Variables|Default|SetQualityChanged true))
  (if (and (not (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)) (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "Q"))
    (Variables|Default|SetIsLow (not (Variables|Default|GetIsLow)))
    (Variables|Default|SetQualityChanged true))
  (if (and (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen) (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "Three"))
    (Variables|Default|SetShadowOff (not (Variables|Default|GetShadowOff)))
    (if (Variables|Default|GetShadowOff)
      (Development|ExecuteConsoleCommand "r.ShadowQuality 0" _returnvalue)
      (else
        (Development|ExecuteConsoleCommand "r.ShadowQuality 3" _returnvalue))))
  (if (Variables|Default|GetQualityChanged)
    (bind _outactors (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageHigh"))
    (for _array_element _outactors
      (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame _array_element _islow))
    (bind _outactors_1 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageLow"))
    (for _array_element_1 _outactors_1
      (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame _array_element_1 (not _islow)))
    (if _islow
      (Development|PrintString "MODEL QUALITY: LOW" true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 2.0)
      (else
        (Development|PrintString "MODEL QUALITY: HIGH" true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 2.0))))
  (if (and (and (not (Variables|Default|GetIsLow)) (not (Variables|Default|GetWheelSolved))) (not (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)))
    (Variables|Default|SetWheelX (+ (Variables|Default|GetWheelX) (* (* DeltaSeconds 100.0) (Variables|Default|GetWheelDirection))))
    (if (> (Variables|Default|GetWheelX) 1420.0)
      (Variables|Default|SetWheelDirection -1.0))
    (if (< (Variables|Default|GetWheelX) 440.0)
      (Variables|Default|SetWheelDirection 1.0)))
  (bind _outactors (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "WheelPiece"))
  (for _array_element _outactors
    (Transformation|SetActorLocationAndRotation _array_element (Math|Vector|MakeVector _wheelx 0.0 (select (< _wheelx 1000.0) (- 184.2 (* _wheelx 0.08)) 100.0)) (Math|Rotator|MakeRotator 0.0 (select _islow_1 0.0 (* (- _wheelx 440.0) -0.572958))) false true))
  (if (and (and _islow_1 (not (Variables|Default|GetWheelSolved))) (and (> _wheelx 1110.0) (< _wheelx 1320.0)))
    (Variables|Default|SetWheelSolved true)
    (bind _outactors_1 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageGate"))
    (for _array_element_1 _outactors_1
      (Rendering|SetActorHiddenInGame _array_element_1 true)
      (Collision|SetActorEnableCollision _array_element_1))
    (bind _outactors_2 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "StageGateVisual"))
    (for _array_element_2 _outactors_2
      (Transformation|SetActorLocation _array_element_2 (Math|Vector|MakeVector 1860.0 -164.0 497.0) false true))
    (Development|PrintString "WHEEL PUZZLE COMPLETE - GATE OPEN" true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 5.0))
  (if (and (not (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)) (Game|Player|WasInputKeyJustPressed _returnvalue "E"))
    (if (and (> (.x (Transformation|GetActorLocation (Game|GetPlayerPawn 0))) 8500.0) (< (.x (Transformation|GetActorLocation (Game|GetPlayerPawn 0))) 8900.0))
      (if _islow_1
        (Development|PrintString "LOW: gear slips. Select HIGH." true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 3.0)
        (else
          (Variables|Default|SetLiftActive true)
          (Development|PrintString "HIGH: gear engaged!" true true "(R=0.000000,G=0.660000,B=1.000000,A=1.000000)" 3.0)))))
  (if (and (and (Variables|Default|GetLiftActive) (not _islow_1)) (not (Variables|Default|GetMenuOpen)))
    (if (< (Variables|Default|GetLiftAlpha) 227.0)
      (Variables|Default|SetLiftAlpha (+ (Variables|Default|GetLiftAlpha) (* DeltaSeconds 35.0)))
      (bind _outactors_1 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "LiftVisual"))
      (for _array_element_1 _outactors_1
        (Transformation|SetActorLocation _array_element_1 (Math|Vector|MakeVector 8700.0 0.0 (+ 15.0 _liftalpha))))
      (bind _outactors_2 (Actor|GetAllActorsWithTag "LiftCollider"))
      (for _array_element_2 _outactors_2
        (Transformation|SetActorLocation _array_element_2 (Math|Vector|MakeVector 8700.0 0.0 (+ 8.0 _liftalpha))))
      (else
        (Variables|Default|SetLiftSolved true)))))
"}
